series.context:
Prior events (Part 1): Gon, Kurapika, and Leorio arrive at Port Dolle. Following the captains clue, Gon and Kurapika take the mountain path while Leorio narrowly avoids a fraudulent bus trap.
Prior events (Part 2): In a deserted town, an eerie examiner tests applicants with an unforgiving two-choice quiz. Arrogant applicant Matthew answers selfishly and is led into a lethal beast den.
Prior events (Part 3): Faced with a cruel question between saving a son or daughter, Leorio nearly attacks the examiner before Kurapika stops him, proving silence is the only acceptable answer.
